governing_intent: Implement a GitHub Projects Anti-Corruption Layer and authenticated direct-webhook ingress that maintain a noncanonical READY view while preserving the fixed upstream-to-execution authority boundary.
summary: PY-05 is bounded, vertically coherent, and executable without inventing Founder or architecture decisions. Its requirement extents are honest: primary for SF-REQ-005, contributing event freshness for SF-REQ-001 and ingress custody for SF-REQ-008.
implementation_unknowns: Concrete GitHub API, webhook-schema, pagination, and source-version handling compatible with recorded fixtures.
Exact typed port, profile-schema, receipt, rejection, and unavailable-outcome representations constrained by PY-03 and PY-04.
Adapter-local conditional-write or serialized projection-fencing mechanism.
Recorded-fixture coverage and local webhook-server harness design.
verification_assessment: Real executable proof is specified: recorded-payload contract tests, a locally served endpoint with real raw-body HMAC verification, durable duplicate/stale-event behavior through PY-03, projection-fencing and outage tests, sentinel secret-leak testing, architecture fitness checks, and the Node suite. Fixture/API research is ordinary implementation work, not a verification gap.
material_risks: Unsupported, ambiguous, missing-membership, incomplete-page, or unsafe-ordering cases must remain typed fail-closed outcomes.
Implementation must preserve PY-03 receipt-before-acknowledgment and expected-version semantics rather than introduce adapter-local durability.
Projection echoes and external execution-display edits must remain drift observations, never lifecycle commands.
next_action: When PY-03 and PY-04 are accepted, release PY-05 against its declared clean-main baseline and resolve the listed implementation details through adapter research and recorded-fixture tests.
rationale: Binding authority fixes ownership, release, transport, authentication, durability, no-polling, configuration, secret handling, and Python/Node coexistence. The remaining details are delegated implementation design. The adapter, ingress, minimal profile/secret adapter, and composition wiring form one profile-scoped integration vertical; splitting would add seams without resolving an independent decision.

provider_evidence.note: reassessment at PY-04-landed baseline, after SWF-23 repair-cycle contract section
